g.title: G
g.text: accuracy.yaml (v2 prompts with group letters, Llama 3B on both lanes, verifier off) + merge rule nudge + the System One decider

g.title: cluster_hard
g.text: Hard path · code · every tick · < 200 ms

g.title: sch
g.text: Scheduler · one queue per lane · priorities P1–P4
ask a side again only when its evidence changes

g.title: gate
g.text: diagnosticians' + decider's offsets summed, cap 1.2 per case
the decider never pushes a filler case

g.title: dec
g.text: one forward pass, no text · median 0.37 s

g.title: pub
g.text: plant state (code) · top-3 causes · actions from the catalogue
